audit.title: Audit log
audit.intro: Every sensitive action with who did it, when, and what changed. Entries cannot be edited or deleted.
audit.empty: No audit entries match these filters.
audit.filter_entity: Show all entries for this entity

booking.title: Booking
booking.clear_exception_body: Mark this exception as handled. Make sure any refund or recovery has been arranged first.
booking.hold_until: Inventory is held until {{time}}. Record a payment before then or the booking expires.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.delete_block_body: Remove this block and make the time available for booking again?
calendar.scope_hint: Block the whole boat or a single area.

cancel_dialog.title: Cancel {{number}}
cancel_dialog.customer_effect: Customer cancellation: the refund follows the cancellation policy stored on the booking and excludes payment fees.
cancel_dialog.operator_effect: Operator cancellation (weather, operator decision): everything paid is refunded in full, including payment fees.
cancel_dialog.done: Booking cancelled. Refunds were created where due.

common.reason_hint: 3–500 characters. Shown in the audit log.

customer.title: Customer
customer.anonymize_body: Permanently remove personal data for {{email}}. Bookings and payments are kept for financial records. This cannot be undone.
customer.anonymized_note: This account was anonymized. Its personal data has been removed.
customer.demote_body: {{email}} loses admin access and is signed out. The last active admin cannot be removed.
customer.disable_body: {{email}} is signed out and can no longer sign in.

departure.title: Departure
departure.cancel_warning: All {{n}} bookings on this departure are cancelled and refunded 100%, including payment fees. Customers are notified. This cannot be undone.
departure.edit_note: Price and capacity changes apply to new bookings only; existing bookings keep their price.

departures.title: Departures
departures.close_hours_hint: Online booking closes this many hours before departure.

issue.EXACTLY_ONE_AREA: A private area slot needs exactly one area.
issue.AREA_REUSED: An area can belong to only one slot.
issue.PRICE_REQUIRED: Enter a price in whole rupiah.
issue.PAX_RANGE: Max guests must be at least min guests.

guests_dialog.title: Edit lead and guests
guests_dialog.fixed_pax: The number of guests is fixed at {{pax}}. Change names and phone numbers only.

identity.confirm_body: The full identity number will be shown and this access is recorded in the audit log. Only reveal it when you need it.

manifest.title: Passenger manifest
manifest.reveal_note: Identity numbers are masked unless you open a "full ID" version. Every full-ID download is recorded in the audit log.

new_booking.title: New manual booking
new_booking.created: Booking {{number}} created. Record the payment to confirm it.
new_booking.customer_hint: Type at least 2 characters of a registered customer's name or email.
new_booking.intro: Manual bookings are paid by recorded payments only. Inventory is held until the admin hold expires; record a payment on the next page.
new_booking.no_departures: No upcoming departures for this boat.
new_booking.rate_hint: Leave on route price unless the boat is booked by hour or day.
new_booking.scheme_hint: Deposit is only accepted when the policy allows it.

overview.title: Overview
overview.upcoming_empty: No confirmed trips in the next 7 days.

partners.title: Partners
partners.intro: Settlement per partner and period, and payouts recorded for it.
partners.bank_missing: This partner has no bank account on file. Add it under Fleet setup before paying out.
partners.choose: Choose a partner and a period to see the settlement.
partners.no_lines: No completed or forfeited bookings in this period.
partners.payout_summary: Pay out {{count}} bookings totalling {{amount}} to {{partner}}. The server recalculates the amount.

payment_dialog.title: Record manual payment
payment_dialog.too_much: The amount cannot exceed the outstanding balance.

payments.title: Payments
payments.create_refund_body: Create a refund for the {{amount}} payment on {{number}}. It then follows the normal refund flow.
payments.exceptions_intro: Payments that arrived for expired or cancelled bookings. Create a refund, or restore the booking manually and clear the exception on the booking.

people.id_number_hint: Stored encrypted; admins see the last 4 characters.

proof.label: Transfer proof
proof.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. Stored privately.
proof.failed: The file could not be processed. Try another image.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.complete_note: A manual refund is complete only once the transfer proof is attached.

reports.title: Reports
reports.intro: Preview a report, then download it as CSV or Excel.
reports.range_note: Dates are inclusive and compared in UTC by the server.
reports.revenue_note: Revenue is succeeded payments minus completed refunds.

requests.cancel_effect: Approving cancels the booking with the customer cancellation policy and creates the refund.
requests.reschedule_effect: Approving only records the decision. Move the booking with Reschedule on the booking page.

reschedule_dialog.title: Reschedule booking
reschedule_dialog.done: Booking rescheduled. A new ticket was issued.
reschedule_dialog.no_slots: No matching upcoming slots on this boat.
reschedule_dialog.note_price: Amounts stay unchanged. Settle any price difference manually.

errors.LAST_ADMIN: This is the last active admin and cannot be disabled or demoted.
errors.CANNOT_MODIFY_SELF: Admin accounts cannot be anonymized. Remove admin access first.
errors.USER_ANONYMIZED: This account is anonymized and cannot be changed.
errors.BLOCK_CONFLICT: The boat already has reservations in this period.
errors.DEPARTURE_SCHEDULE_CONFLICT: The boat is already reserved for part of this time.
errors.IDENTITY_PURGED: The identity number has been deleted after the retention period.
errors.REFUND_INVALID_TRANSITION: The refund cannot move to that status. Reload and try again.
errors.REFUND_EXISTS: A refund already exists for this payment.
errors.SETTLEMENT_LINE_UNAVAILABLE: A selected booking is not payable in this period or is already paid. Reload the settlement.
errors.SETTLEMENT_ALREADY_PAID: A selected booking was already paid out.
errors.MULTIPART_INVALID: The file could not be uploaded.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect.
errors.ADMIN_EXISTS: An admin with this email already exists.

admins.added: Admin created. They can sign in with this email and password.

account.title: Change password
account.changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
